patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Three distinct lows visible: left shoulder around 1775, head around 1720, right shoulder around 1775-1780. Neckline resistance around 1800-1825. Price has rallied above neckline to approximately 1830.

patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Market structure shifted from lower lows/lower highs to higher lows after the ~1720 low. Price broke above prior swing high around 1800-1825, confirming bullish CHoCH.

patterns_found.name: Ascending Triangle
patterns_found.evidence: Higher lows forming after the 1720 low, with price repeatedly testing resistance near 1830-1840.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Inverse head and shoulders structure completed with breakout above neckline; change of character from bearish to bullish; price holding above key support levels.
